reply:
**Status: Referred to a claims handler**

The claim has been escalated to a human handler with reason "other". Nothing has been approved, staged or paid. The escalation returned no separate reference number.

**Facts recorded**
- Policyholder: Claire Martin, policy VER-1001, Peugeot 208 (2021), registration FG-218-LM. Licensed since 2012-05-14.
- Coverage: C2 collision damage (damage to her own car). C2 is in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident: 12 October 2026 at 17:15, Rue de Rivoli / Rue du Renard crossing, Paris. Reported 14 October 2026. No injuries and no other objects damaged.
- Other vehicle: Ford Transit Custom van, GA-845-HN, a company vehicle of Rapid Livraisons SARL, insured with Axelia Pro Assurances. Driver: Marc Dubois. The email only said "another vehicle", so the van details come from the accident report.
- Circumstances: Ms. Martin was going straight on at the crossing and had a green light. Mr. Dubois says he did not see the light turn red and accepts responsibility.
- Repair quote Q-2610-5209 (Carrosserie Saint-Paul, 13 October 2026): 1,200.00 EUR incl. VAT (1,000.00 EUR excl. VAT). The quote says any additional damage found during repair will be quoted separately.
- Documents: accident_report_signed.pdf, repair_quote.pdf and damage_photos.zip. All belong to VER-1001 and vehicle FG-218-LM, so all count as provided. Nothing is missing, so no documents were requested.
- The email and the accident report agree on the date and location. The report says Vehicle B came from the right, while the email does not say which side.

**Reasoning**
- Coverage: C2 covers damage to the insured vehicle, and the schedule includes it. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1"/>
- Not-at-fault waiver: no deductible applies when the insured is not at fault and the third party is identified. Both apply here. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>
- Payout: compensation is the repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>
- Assessor: not required, because the repair cost is not above 1,500 EUR. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>
- Referral: the playbook says a claim with a commercial other-party vehicle (van, truck, lorry or delivery vehicle) goes to a handler so Veridia can recover from the other insurer. The accident report states a van owned by a delivery company, so this rule applies. The contract's referral article (Article 7) does not list this case, so the referral rests on the playbook.
- Possible exclusions: none found. The story shows no alcohol, licence, racing or wear issues.
- Reporting: reported two days after the incident. The system marked it as on time.

**Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Deductible: €0.00 (not-at-fault waiver)
- Payout: €1,200.00 (before any handler decision)
- Assessor required: No

**Open points for the handler**
- The signature fields in the accident report text show no visible names. The email says the other driver signed, so please confirm the signatures.
- The other insurer's policy number is given only as "see insurer certificate". It will be needed for the recovery claim from Axelia Pro Assurances.
- Additional damage found during repair may need a supplementary quote.

**Draft message to the customer**
> Dear Ms. Martin,
> Thank you for your claim about the accident of 12 October 2026 (policy VER-1001, reference DOCS-final-DOC-02). We have received your accident report, repair quote and photos. Your claim has been passed to a claims handler, who will review it and contact you about the next steps. If the repair finds more damage, please send us the supplementary quote.
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims

**Memory:** I created `customers/VER-1001.md` with one dated line for the email date (2026-10-14) recording the claim reference, coverage, the referral and the open points.
